title: Update the flight-controller configuration after the GPS moved to UART3

steps.note: the model change: the GNSS lead's UART wires are soldered to the UART3 pads (the configuration still says UART1)

instruction: We re-soldered the GPS lead to the flight controller's UART3 pads, and the model (src/quadcopter.uhd.ts) already says so. Bring the flight controller's Betaflight configuration in firmware/ up to date with the model, and tell me which serial port lines changed.

graders.description: the generator's output for the model, as the reference for the next grader
cli.txt is exactly what the generator makes from the model: regenerated, not patched by hand

solution.say: Regenerated firmware/betaflight/cli.txt from the model (run betaflight-cli): the GPS serial line moved from `serial UART1 2 …` to `serial UART3 2 115200 115200 0 115200`; UART1 is now unused. The receiver (UART2) and DJI MSP (UART5) lines are unchanged.
